caseActions.heading: Actions
caseActions.empty.title: No actions yet
caseActions.empty.body: Add what must be done, with an owner and a due date. The first action starts the implementation.
caseActions.removeBody: It leaves the list and no longer counts as open. The case file still shows it was planned and removed.
caseActions.ownerHint: {name} owns it, as the case's owner.
caseActions.locked: Actions are locked while this case waits for sign-off. Sending it back unlocks them.
caseActions.lockedRefusal: This case now waits for sign-off, so its actions can no longer change.
